entityFieldPolicy: BASELINE.json preserves every canonical field including nulls, aliases and crosswalks. research.json contains entity-specific interpretation; no canonical repairs. Null timeScaleQualifier is unspecified, not a governance block.
rdsReview: No RDS member in this Family. No direct RDS effect target or calculated attitude index used as a manipulable entity.

layersConsidered.BIO: Human food pleasantness/satiety and mood-related expectancy searches; latent biological Driver versus exposure and outcome-proxy mismatch remain research-needed.
layersConsidered.PSY: Belief, valence, confidence, intention, expectancy, relevance and learning mechanisms; measured mediators not assumed causal.
layersConsidered.SOC: Source testimony and interpersonal feedback; topic-specific exposure distinguished from trust in the speaker. No full external Family audit.
layersConsidered.CUL: Cross-cultural success/failure feedback search found persistence/task-value outcomes, not an exact Cultural Driver manipulation. Nationality is not a moderator entity.
layersConsidered.ENV: Noise and disaster searches returned mostly observational risk/hearing beliefs. No exact independently identified F01 effect retained.
layersConsidered.INS: Institutional assignment/feedback/incentives considered; offered benefit is not outcome probability. Hypothetical policy applicability in persuasion tasks is not an actual enacted policy.
layersConsidered.INF: Message repetition, correction/refutation, framing and expectancy communication supplied most exact-target evidence.
layersConsidered.TEC: Online presentation is a delivery/affordance origin, not evidence of an algorithm's independent causal effect. No inferred live-platform optimization.

domainsConsidered.DELIBERATE_INTERVENTION: Controlled presentation/refutation, involvement manipulations, framing and expectancy challenges.
domainsConsidered.ROUTINE_UNINTENDED_HUMAN_ACTIVITY: Ordinary repeated encounters and eating are possible origins, but experimental protocols are not automatic real-world-effect generalizations.
domainsConsidered.EXTERNAL_EVENT_SHOCK: Disaster beliefs screened; no sufficiently aligned identified effect.
domainsConsidered.ENVIRONMENTAL_EXPOSURE: Noise/physical stressor search primarily located different constructs and observational designs.
domainsConsidered.INSTITUTIONAL_STRUCTURAL_CHANGE: Rules/incentives/feedback considered; no independent exact outcome-probability effect verified.
domainsConsidered.TECHNOLOGICAL_CHANGE: Platform presentation may change encounters; capability is not realized dose or effect.
domainsConsidered.SOCIAL_NETWORK_EVENT_PROCESS: Social testimony/feedback considered, not a social tie as a PSYWERX scientific Relationship.
domainsConsidered.INFORMATIONAL_EXPOSURE: Repeated claim and explanatory refutation protocols retained for candidate review.
domainsConsidered.BIOLOGICAL_PHYSIOLOGICAL_PROCESS: Transient satiety/mood pathways considered; no stable-trait or generic valuation effect inferred.

driverLedgers.noFinding: No exact reusable action-to-behavior-attitude candidate retained: conditioning studies often target object liking; framing has a reported undetected attitude advantage and unreconciled erratum. This is not evidence all attitude interventions fail.
driverLedgers.gaps: Exact behavior-referent manipulations, control for bundled cognitions, and duration beyond immediate attitude assessment.
driverLedgers.qualifiers: Valence/persuasion depends on behavior and prior opinion; prevention behavior is not an attitude proxy; neither benefits nor harms rated generically.

driverLedgers.noFinding: Counterarguing/perceived-message-strength manipulation concerns certainty only. A whole Attitude Strength effect would exceed evidence; no profile-dimension effect is smuggled through a LEVEL direction.
driverLedgers.gaps: Independent certainty versus accessibility/stability/resistance measures; aligned intention effects and longitudinal resistance.
driverLedgers.qualifiers: Measured elaboration/trait need-for-cognition are not randomized moderators; reinforcing an unfavorable belief can be harmful depending on criterion.

driverLedgers.noFinding: No separately retained relationship-targeted effect; initial accuracy instructions are a boundary of a not-yet-governed candidate edge, not a formal edge-targeted assertion.
driverLedgers.gaps: No generalized magnitude, independent persistence effect, causal mediation or live-platform effect. Confidence in a claim may overlap PSY-116.
driverLedgers.qualifiers: Mixed/null contrasts and task/country differences explicit; no synergy/antagonism or recommendation inferred; shared repetition contribution cannot be summed twice.

driverLedgers.noFinding: Expectancy-challenge studies do change domain-specific expectancy measures, but positive/negative expectancy scales and differing treatment packages cannot yet be mapped to a single exact action-consequence probability and reusable operation from the accessed abstract.
driverLedgers.gaps: Named consequence, probability versus desirability measurement, exact challenge identity/components; no alcohol administration recommendation.
driverLedgers.qualifiers: College versus school samples and dose vary; mediated drinking changes not causally inferred from meta-regression.

driverLedgers.noFinding: Food pleasantness may index transient food valuation, but consumed-food score versus value of a possible future outcome was not sufficiently aligned. Rodent instrumental responding does not fill this gap.
driverLedgers.gaps: Separate sensory familiarity/habituation from satiety signal and independently elicited possible-outcome value.
driverLedgers.qualifiers: Food-specific and within-meal, not moral/monetary values or stable preferences. No generalized beneficial direction.

driverLedgers.noFinding: Feedback/mood/expectancy screening did not provide a sufficiently extracted exact action-to-task-success probability effect. Positive motivation and persistence outcomes are not success expectancy.
driverLedgers.gaps: Separate ability, success criterion, opportunity and incentive motivation; exact accurate-feedback contrast needed.
driverLedgers.qualifiers: Within-task expectation not stable optimism; between-culture difference not a within-person causal cultural intervention.

driverLedgers.noFinding: Personal-involvement instructions create a relevance manipulation context, but no independently extracted direct relevance measurement qualifies a target effect here. Policy timing description is not enacted institutional change.
driverLedgers.gaps: Noncircular relevance indicator; distinguish source/argument sensitivity from total elaboration depth.
driverLedgers.qualifiers: Undergraduate policy scenario, hypothetical applicability; no automatic transfer to personal identity or every decision.

propertyPolicy: All eleven properties are explicitly considered in generated ledgers; unextracted quantitative/dynamic properties remain NOT_INVESTIGATED, not zero. STRUCTURE is NOT_APPLICABLE for direct effects on these scalar/profile psychological constructs; no ontology edits or context loopholes.
relationshipPropertyReview: All nine exact existing causal IDs were screened for eleven properties after their local review. Strength/direction/enablement/functional-shape/structure effects have insufficient independent exact-edge evidence; remaining unresearched dynamics stay NOT_INVESTIGATED. PSY-002 moderation of REL-PSY-001 remains a research question, not an ordinary M→outcome replacement.

skepticalReview.method: Separate second pass by the same automated researcher after source extraction and initial hypotheses; not falsely described as an independent human review.
checks: Challenged the source-strength generalization: Tormala uses attitude certainty, not all strength dimensions; no direct strength-profile effect retained.
Rechecked author metadata: added Geert Crombez to Hofmann meta-analysis after Crossref verification; no canonical source edited.
Challenged repetition monotonicity with 2026 synthesis and accuracy-instruction results: retained context-dependent direction and mixed evidence instead of universal increase.
Challenged correction generalization: retained only refutation-versus-retraction week contrast; one-day null and broader science-correction heterogeneity remain explicit.
Did not use nonrandom no-exposure group in Ecker Experiment 1 as randomized evidence; did not substitute inference scores for belief ratings.
Kept familiarity mediation uncreated; repetition manipulates encounters, not necessarily familiarity as an independently identified mediator.
Rejected score/formula causality and confidence/accuracy equivalence; comparison does not resolve PSY-003 versus PSY-116 overlap.
No negative frame effect inferred from nonsignificance; framing erratum remains review-needed and no effect candidate retained.
No self-efficacy/expectancy merger based on conceptual critique; competing theory and measurement interpretation remain for human review.
Source overlap is conservative: trials and later syntheses are not counted as independent replications; no numerical pooling performed.
No candidate changes prior INF-F03/SOC-F07/BIO-F01 science. No direct RDS effect or quantitative/practitioner eligibility.

Layer-wide random sample re-opened the implausibility boundary: 2022 preregistered five-presentation/100-point-scale result is explicit alongside the 2018 null. Different protocol, not proof of a dose/scale moderator; no universal exclusion. MIXED context-dependent candidate scope retained.
skepticalReview.remainingRisks: Layer-level PSY-003/PSY-116 boundary review may downgrade the belief candidates; scientific scope and measurement are explicit for human review, not automatically activatable. Full-source verification gaps limit several existing-edge recommendations.
